lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's one hundred eighty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 180? Nope!

lines.text: Seven evenly spaced points, each joined to the second point after it.
lines.caption: 7 evenly spaced points, each joined to the second point after it.

lines.text: What do the seven tip angles add up to?
lines.caption: What do the 7 tip angles add up to?

lines.text: Walk a pencil around the star. At each tip, the tip and the turn make one hundred eighty.
lines.caption: Walk a pencil around the star. At each tip, the tip and the turn make 180.

lines.text: Watch it go all the way around. The pencil circles the center twice!
lines.caption: Watch it go all the way around. The pencil circles the center twice!

lines.text: Two circles is seven hundred twenty degrees of turning.
lines.caption: 2 circles is 720 degrees of turning.

lines.text: Seven times one hundred eighty, minus seven hundred twenty. That's five hundred forty degrees!
lines.caption: 7 times 180, minus 720. That's 540 degrees!

lines.text: One hundred eighty was the trap. That's the five-point star.
lines.caption: 180 was the trap. That's the 5-point star.

lines.text: Did you get five hundred forty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 540? Tell me below!
